items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Specific critical CVEs include CVE-2026-48356 (Unrestricted File Upload) and CVE-2026-48358 (Improper Output Encoding leading to RCE).

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a security update for 25 Magento extensions, with at least one critical vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: CISA Adds Exploited Magento RCE Flaw CVE-2026-45247 to KEV Catalog
items.summary: This critical deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension allows unauthenticated remote code execution and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source, including critical issues like CVE-2026-34686 (Stored XSS leading to arbitrary code execution) and CVE-2026-34653 (Path Traversal leading to arbitrary file system write).

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: PolyShell is a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image, with widespread exploitation attempts observed. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without backports.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-05
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and access store data. It fixes 19 CVEs, including CVE-2026-21290 (Stored XSS, CVSS 8.7) and other critical Stored XSS issues.
